name: controlab
description: ControLAB - Suíte interativa e didática de Engenharia e Sistemas de Controle

scripts.mobile:open: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && node scripts/run-gradle.js assembleDebug
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/assert-platform.js linux && npm run package:python && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage deb rpm --publish never
scripts.package:windows: node scripts/assert-platform.js win32 && npm run package:python && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --publish never
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:python
